import sys, json, math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    hexstr = data[1]
    b = bytes.fromhex(hexstr)
    assert len(b) == n
    # bits
    bits = []
    for byte in b:
        for i in range(7, -1, -1):
            bits.append((byte >> i) & 1)
    total_bits = len(bits)
    ones = sum(bits)
    zeros = total_bits - ones
    # Shannon entropy per bit using bit frequencies
    if ones == 0 or zeros == 0:
        entropy_per_bit = 0.0
    else:
        p1 = ones / total_bits
        p0 = zeros / total_bits
        entropy_per_bit = -(p1*math.log2(p1) + p0*math.log2(p0))
    # Frequency test: bit ratio within 0.5 +/- 0.1
    ratio = ones / total_bits
    frequency_test_pass = abs(ratio - 0.5) <= 0.1
    # Runs test: count runs
    runs = 1
    for i in range(1, total_bits):
        if bits[i] != bits[i-1]:
            runs += 1
    # Expected runs ~ 2*n*p*(1-p) + 1 ; pass if |runs - expected| < 2*sqrt(2n*p*(1-p))
    p = ratio
    if p == 0 or p == 1:
        runs_test_pass = False
    else:
        expected_runs = 2 * total_bits * p * (1-p)
        std = math.sqrt(2 * total_bits * p * (1-p) * (2*total_bits*p*(1-p) - 1) / (total_bits - 1)) if total_bits > 1 else 0
        if std == 0:
            runs_test_pass = False
        else:
            z = abs(runs - expected_runs) / std
            runs_test_pass = z < 1.96
    # Chi-square test on byte frequencies
    freq = [0]*256
    for byte in b:
        freq[byte] += 1
    expected = n / 256
    if expected > 0:
        chi_square = sum((f - expected)**2 / expected for f in freq)
    else:
        chi_square = 0.0
    # 255 degrees of freedom, 95% critical value ~ 293.2478
    chi_square_pass = chi_square < 293.2478
    # Quality
    passes = sum([frequency_test_pass, runs_test_pass, chi_square_pass])
    if passes == 3 and entropy_per_bit > 0.99:
        quality = 'excellent'
    elif passes == 3:
        quality = 'good'
    elif passes == 2:
        quality = 'fair'
    else:
        quality = 'poor'
    out = {
        'entropy_per_bit': round(entropy_per_bit, 6),
        'frequency_test_pass': frequency_test_pass,
        'runs_test_pass': runs_test_pass,
        'chi_square': round(chi_square, 4),
        'chi_square_pass': chi_square_pass,
        'quality': quality
    }
    print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
